keywords = [
    KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.FLYING),
]
abilities = [
    # [0]
    TriggeredAbility(
        event=ZoneChangeEvent(
            from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
            to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
            subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
        ),
        condition=None,
        effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
            'amount': QConst(value=3),
            'controller': ControllerRef.YOU,
            'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
            'from': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
            'journal_kind': 'MILL',
            'pop_order': 'TOP',
        }),
    ),
    # [1]
    StaticAbility(
        effect=A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
            'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=2)),
            'target': Selector(
                count=QConst(value=1),
                mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
            ),
            'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=1)),
        }),
        condition=FAtom(
            pred=FAtomPred.QTY_GE,
            count=QConst(value=7),
            quantity=QCount(
                selector=Selector(
                    count=QUnbounded(),
                    mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                    filter=FAnd(children=()),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
                ),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    # [2]
    SpellAbility(kind=SpellKind.CREATURE),
]

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, mill three cards.
clauses.ir: abilities[0] (MOVE_ZONE journal_kind MILL, 3 from the top of your library)

clauses.clause: Threshold — This creature gets +2/+1 as long as there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.
clauses.ir: abilities[1] (StaticAbility: +2/+1 on this creature; condition at_least(7, quantity=number_in(...)) your graveyard)

mapping.notes: Carrion Grub's verified mill with three; the threshold static is Elvish Reclaimer's verified StaticAbility.condition with Crypt Feaster's verified at_least(7, quantity=number_in(...)) over your graveyard, +2/+1 on the source. Flying compiles; Threshold is an ability word. Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/billowing_shriekmass_no_threshold_at_six_cards.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/billowing_shriekmass_threshold_at_seven_cards.json. Ontology round R12: the tree translated into the one comparison (same meaning), the draft, clauses and notes reworded.
